question: Which of the following is the most electronegative element?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cl**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chlorine (Cl)** is the **most electronegative element **among the given options.
 
• Electronegativity is a measure of the tendency of an atom to **attract a bonding pair of electrons**.
 
• In the periodic table, electronegativity increases across a period and decreases down a group.&
